criteria.findings: Nine west upper groups and nine narrow middle openings restore a supported three-register rhythm. The front upper glass is hidden/blocked in the rendered asset; north and south remain blank simplified panels. West middle full pale jambs and generic basement windows do not match the photographed sill/keystone and basement register. Exact bay positions and opening dimensions remain estimates.

The entrance stair, pale surrounds, central pavilion and west upper stepped frame cues are recognizable. Front arches are semicircular instead of the shallow segmental profiles shown in the source. The west door needs its transom, realistic frame division and recessed/downward approach; eave brackets and facade masonry/stone motifs remain simplified.

The broad hipped red roof and projecting entry pavilion are retained, with exact preservation of the GIS shell and roof geometry in this revision. Eave depth/details, absolute height and facade/roof proportions are not established by calibrated elevation or complete exterior evidence.

criteria.criterion: Materials, color, scale, trim and depth
criteria.findings: Red-brown masonry, pale stone and dark west glazing are plausible basic materials. The broad pale limestone basement zone remains brick in the model, front pale surfaces suppress photographed brick inlay articulation, upper front glazing appears opaque pale, and some retained masonry mapping is stretched. West glazing is surfaced onto a solid backing rather than having a verified wall opening/recess.

criteria.criterion: Whole-building consistency across elevations and obliques
criteria.findings: The west facade is materially more legible than the baseline. The remaining elevations retain substantially lower detail and large blank areas. No complete current north elevation or calibrated full-building reference set supports whole-building acceptance.

findings.finding: The three pavilion upper windows render as pale blocked panels; glass meshes HAAS_Photo_Glazing_-7.65_7.7, HAAS_Photo_Glazing_0_7.7 and HAAS_Photo_Glazing_7.65_7.7 lie at X=12.76–12.82 behind facade/jamb geometry near X=13.0–13.25.
findings.required_correction: Create correct openings/recesses and dark visible glazing/mullions, then re-render from a matched front oblique. Do not fix by recoloring the blocking stone.

findings.finding: The real pale limestone register extends around the basement windows/door with rectangular red-brick insets; the model adds only a thin stripe while retaining a predominantly brick basement.
findings.required_correction: Rebuild the west basement stone/brick distribution and frame/recess relationships from the current entrance and 2016 elevated views.

findings.facade: west middle windows and west entrance
findings.finding: Full pale window jambs are too heavy relative to the narrow dark openings with sill and keystone in Street View. The door lacks the upper transom and recessed approach.
findings.required_correction: Use the photographed middle-window trim profile and door/transom proportions; confirm the door bay with a footprint/plan comparison rather than a guessed station.

findings.finding: The model has semicircular arch profiles and broad pale blank wall areas; the reference has shallow segmental openings and more precise alternating masonry/stone inlays.
findings.required_correction: Match arch rise/profile and surrounding brick panels/quoins against the official exterior photograph. Preserve the entrance silhouette while refining it.

findings.finding: Both rendered elevations remain near-blank grids; the winter oblique shows at least the visible side has upper and basement windows, not a wholly blank wall. The opposite elevation remains insufficiently documented.
findings.required_correction: Obtain distinct, correctly oriented elevation/corner views and model their actual openings. Do not mirror west windows onto unseen walls as a substitute for evidence.

findings.finding: A broad hipped red roof is supported, but roof/eave dimensions, fine tile/eave details and absolute facade heights remain uncalibrated estimates.
findings.required_correction: Use additional roof/aerial views or elevations to refine supported details; retain explicit uncertainty where metric evidence is absent.

Photo-derived widths, heights, bay positions, roof/eave dimensions and door station are estimates.
